caseTitle: responsive: representative route families in the missing skins and short-phone sizes

observations.text: Additive representative layouts only: non-phone projects add all four skins; the phone project adds all four short-phone skins. Existing full-phone skin evidence and every original record/picture are retained. This is not every state/skin/width combination or deployed proof.

Responsive palette sampling uses the existing owned screenshot fixture to set the stored skin and document attribute; real appearance-picker persistence and selection remain asserted in the original settings case. These are layout pictures, not new preference behavior.
